content:
I'm working on a framework to build iOS apps with Lean:

https://github.com/paulcadman/lean-ios

It contains:

  1. A modified Lean4 source tree so that the Lean runtime and stage0 standard
    library can be compiled with the iOS toolchain and linked into native iOS
    apps.

  2. Lean Bindings for SDL3 / SDL3_ttf.

  3. Common Makefiles and C framework for building iOS SDL3 apps.

  4. Some examples you can build and run on the iOS simulator and devices,
    including flappy bird!
